endorsements.quote: Invest in education and training: health care professionals and students must be equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge to effectively use and critically evaluate AI technologies.

Promote transparency and accountability: it must be ensured that AI systems used in health care and medical education are transparent and open to scrutiny, while being accessible and applicable across all clinical working and learning environments.

unlisted_practices: Develop a robust ethical framework for AI use in health care and medical education through collaboration among health care professionals, educators, policy makers, patients, and the public.
Foster interdisciplinary collaboration among health care professionals, educators, computer scientists, and clinical informatics experts in developing and implementing AI technologies.
Establish clear regulatory standards and legal structures that hold stakeholders responsible for AI systems' performance.
Regularly assess the impact of AI technologies on health care and medical education to identify risks and benefits, focusing on equitable access.
Ensure equitable access to AI-driven resources and education across all clinical working and learning environments.

screen.reason: This is a perspective/scenario-planning commentary describing future visions and recommendations for governing and educating around AI in medical education and healthcare.
